title: The man as he stands on the target card, and you on the C card: aimed at you, the pistol aimed, kneeling, down, cowering; you kneeling, with a G-11, the P-12, prone
about: Your note of 2026-11-17: "the portraits need to be more dynamic and show us what we would be seeing, including what they are holding" (and your rule of 2026-11-12, "anything that moves is shown moving"). Until now the card drew every man standing, his gear as worn, whatever he did. Each picture is one candidate, drawn by the game's own doll and card code on the portraits round's pose engine (C's: the poses as bends of the doll, the holds on the gear's places): first today's card for comparison, then the candidate on the target card at the near, mid and far bands (4, 14 and 30 m), the live lane's role-player (utilities, the plate carrier, the force-on-force mask, the R-7; his P-12 out for P); then the moment moving: the card at its paint rate (it repaints only when what you see changes, so before and after) beside the stage's frames of the same moment, toward you, three times their size. Y is you on the C card as in a mirror (today's doll, then the candidate's, twice their size). Drawn in this release at the defaults A1, P1, K1, D1, C1 and Y-p (the poses ship at their defaults, question 16); your picks replace them, in v0.0.24 if they land after the merge.

open.decides: the man as he stands on the target card (A, P, K, D, C) and you prone on the C card (Y-p)

groups.title: A: a rifle aimed at you
groups.about: Moving: the low ready, then aimed; the stage's low ready, raise and aim.

views.name: A1: end on, the muzzle a ring at his chest (the default)
A2: canted, the rifle across his chest

groups.title: P: a pistol aimed at you
groups.about: The P-12 out, the R-7 slung. Moving: the pistol at the ready, then aimed; the stage's draw and pistol aimed.

views.name: P1: both arms out, the slide end on (the default)

groups.title: K: kneeling (a check)
groups.about: Moving: standing aimed, then kneeling aimed; the stage's aim, the knee going down and the kneeling aim.

views.name: K1: on the right knee, aimed (the default)

groups.title: D: down, ruled out and sitting where he is
groups.about: Moving: standing at the low ready, then sitting; the stage's low ready and sitting low. D2 is a new bend, drawn on a card composed by the card's own geometry.

views.name: D1: sitting, the rifle across his knees (the default)

groups.title: C: cowering (a check)
groups.about: Moving: standing at the low ready, then crouched; the stage draws a frozen man as he stands.

views.name: C1: crouched, the fists at his head (the default)

groups.title: Y: you on the C card, as in a mirror
groups.about: The black combat EVA suit, the carrier, the R-7, the P-12 on the thigh. Y-p is the default of its own question (you prone on the C card); the others are checks of the I and C cards.

views.name: Y-p: prone, behind the rifle, end on (the default)
Y-k: kneeling, the rifle at the low ready
Y-g: a G-11 in the fist
Y-12: the P-12 at the ready
